Method.name: ProcessHttpsRequest
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method ProcessHttpsRequest")
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New()
Set httprequest.Server = ..Adapter.HTTPServer $$$TRACE("Http Server: "_httprequest.Server) Set httprequest.Port = ..Adapter.HTTPPort $$$TRACE("Http Port: "_httprequest.Port) Set httprequest.Location = ..Adapter.URL $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig $$$TRACE("SSL Config: "_httprequest.SSLConfiguration)
Set httprequest.Https="1"
do httprequest.SetHeader("Content-Type","application/json")
do httprequest.SetHeader("Authorization",pRequest.authToken)
do httprequest.EntityBody.Write(pRequest.body)
try { Set writer=##class(%Net.MIMEWriter).%New() Set status=writer.OutputToStream(httprequest.EntityBody) s postStatus = httprequest.Post(httprequest.Location)
$$$TRACE("Resp Status: "_postStatus) if (postStatus =1){ $$$TRACE(" Webcollect Azure service..Post Successful.") set len = httprequest.HttpResponse.ContentLength $$$TRACE(" len: "_len)
set respData = httprequest.HttpResponse.Data.Read() $$$TRACE(" respData: "_respData) set code = httprequest.HttpResponse.StatusCode $$$TRACE(" respData: "_respData)
$$$TRACE("RESP DATA : "_respData_" Status Code :"_code)
set response=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_response.StatusLine) do ..constructResponse(response,.jwtResponse)
set pResponse=jwtResponse
}else{ set errTxt = " RETRY. Webcollect service post request failed." $$$TRACE(" Post Failed.. " _ errTxt) set tSC = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).RetryMsgError(..%ConfigName,errTxt)
} } catch e { $$$TRACE(" Unknown Exception: " _ e) set errTxt = $System.Status.GetErrorText("Unknown Exception while calling Webcollect Https service. "_e) Set tSC = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).DisableMsgError(..%ConfigName,errTxt)
} quit tSC
